name: terminal-tweaks
description: Small tweaks to the Claude Code terminal, each one switched on or off in /config: the time on your messages, a frame around them, and when you last wrote

messageTime.title: Time on your messages
messageTime.description: Show the date and time each of your messages was sent, on the right of the message

dateFormat.title: Date format
dateFormat.description: How the date is written, on your messages and in the last message line

todayDate.title: Date on today's messages
todayDate.description: Show the date on messages sent today too; off, they show the time alone

messageFrame.title: Frame around your messages
messageFrame.description: Draw a frame around each of your messages so they stand out from Claude's replies

frameStyle.title: Frame style
frameStyle.description: The frame's border; quote draws a bar on the left alone

frameColor.title: Frame color
frameColor.description: A color of your theme, so the frame follows the light or dark theme you use

lastMessage.title: Last message line
lastMessage.description: Show under the prompt when you last sent a message in this session and how long ago
